newsitem.title: UK: Littlewoods shareholder forum backs board.
newsitem.headline: Littlewoods shareholder forum backs board.

text.p: Shareholders of Littlewoods, the privately held British home shopping-to-football pools group, are supporting the board's strategy on its stores and decision to sell 19 outlets to Marks and Spencer Plc, a spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"Shareholders are firmly behind the board and its proposed strategy for the stores and the sale of 19 stores to Marks and Spencer," she said.
Reports in the British press on Monday suggested some Littlewoods' shareholders were unhappy with the 192.5 million pound deal with M&S, which will mean redundancies of between 1,700 and 1,800.
Shareholders had met in London on Tuesday for a forum, the spokeswoman added.
"They reaffirmed their complete confidence in the chairman and the board of the company," she said.
